messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: service=canary-release-monitor severity=critical incident=INC-20260315-0093
pd-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty -> page sent to devon (oncall), escalations enabled
devon: acked. I'm on it — pulling logs and stopping the rollout.
deploy-bot: auto-deploy hook triggered: release=canary/2026-03-15-7, shard=eu-west-1. Canary healthcheck failing (5m fail rate spike).
aj: seen the alert in telemetry — p50 ok, p95 up, error rate ~4.8% for generation route /v1/generate in eu-west-1. Repro on curl?
devon: running quick curl against a canary instance...
devon: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://eu-canary-3.redwood/api/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
```
devon: response: 502 Bad Gateway + "kernel OOM" in container logs. Attaching tail of logs:
devon: ```
[2026-03-15T01:02:34Z] ERROR runtime: segfault in quant-exec at 0x7f9...
[2026-03-15T01:02:34Z] WARN kvcache: eviction spike, free pages < 5%
[2026-03-15T01:02:35Z] ERROR http: upstream 127.0.0.1:9500 returned 502
```
maria: hmm kernel OOM on node-level sounds like quant/llm worker OOM after model hotload. Any memory config changes in this release?
aj: release notes show quant-path optimization enabled by default for 2 model families. Might be more memory-hungry on our small canary flavor.
kevin: customer impact: telemetry shows ~12k requests affected across eu-west in the last 8 minutes, roughly 0.8% of total EU traffic. Major paying customers: two embeddings-heavy customers saw failures for short windows. CS pinged.
aj: propose immediate mitigation: pause rollout + divert traffic off canary pool to stable pool in region, and kick a rollback for canaries if pause doesn't stabilize in 5m. Thoughts?
devon: +1. I'll pause rollout now. @deploy-bot please pause canary and divert traffic.
deploy-bot: pausing rollout: release=canary/2026-03-15-7 ... traffic diversion command: `routectl divert --from=canary-eu --to=stable-eu --percent=100`
deploy-bot: running: `routectl divert --from=canary-eu --to=stable-eu --percent=100`
deploy-bot: diversion complete. Canary instances drained. New traffic now routing to stable pool.
maria: running healthchecks after diversion — running synthetic load against stable pool. p95 generation latency normalizing; error rate for generation route dropping to 0.2% over last 30s.
kevin: CS update: customers which saw failures have been contacted, we provided ETA for mitigation (traffic diversion completed). No SLA hits yet; monitoring closely.
aj: recommend rollback for the canary image to previous release to avoid re-rollout blips later. If we rollback canary tag 7 -> tag 6, that should clear the queue. Who will execute?
devon: I'll trigger rollback. Command: `redwood-deploy rollback --target canary/2026-03-15-7 --to canary/2026-03-15-6 --region eu-west-1`
devon: executing...
devon: ```
$ redwood-deploy rollback --target canary/2026-03-15-7 --to canary/2026-03-15-6 --region eu-west-1
Rolling back 3 nodes in eu-west-1...
Stopping canary instances... OK
Replacing images... OK
Healthchecks: OK, all nodes healthy
Rollback complete: 3/3 nodes replaced, release now at canary/2026-03-15-6
```
deploy-bot: rollback observed and recorded: incident_tag=INC-20260315-0093 action=rollback complete=true
maria: re-running full telemetry pass — error rate returned to baseline across eu-west-1. No further OOMs observed in logs for the past 2 minutes.
kevin: marking customer impact as "transient errors" in incident tracker; CS queued follow-ups and offer of credits if customers request.
aj: we should keep the canary disabled until we adjust memory settings or revert quant-path change for the small flavor. Action: create ticket in infra with priority P1. Owner: aj.
aj: ticket created: INFRA-3321 "quant-path default enabled causes OOM on small canary flavor" link: https://reds.example/INFRA-3321
devon: adding post-incident items: run full regression on quant-path changes, add safety cap to canary memory allocation and add preflight that simulates hotload. I'll take on the preflight item.
maria: good. I'll own the monitoring alert tweak — change alert threshold to require 2m sustained OOM/error spike before auto-page to reduce noisy paging.
pd-bot: PagerDuty: incident INC-20260315-0093 acknowledged by devon, status: resolved (mitigated, rollback+traffic diversion).
devon: closing this thread, will write short blameless incident note. Thanks all :heart: 
kevin: nice quick work team. :thumbsup:
